title: Sr Product Marketing Manager
description_excerpt:
What is the role:
Offchain is looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive go-to-market and growth for ZeroDev, our smart account and wallet infrastructure for developers, fintechs and financial institutions building programmable finance. This role is made for a builder who thrives at the intersection of product, sales and growth, and who can connect every campaign to pipeline and revenue.
This is a full-stack role. One week you're shipping a launch; the next you're working in HubSpot and supporting commercial proposals with Sales. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales and the wider Offchain marketing team to shape positioning, run campaigns and grow ZeroDev's footprint with both crypto-native builders and enterprise buyers.
What you'll do:
Develop product positioning, messaging and competitive framing across the ZeroDev product line, and evolve it as products mature.
Define go-to-market plans and run launches end to end, developing content for landing pages, blogs, emails, demos, social, one-pagers and internal enablement.
Run content, search and lifecycle programs. Own the X and LinkedIn calendar, SEO and answer-engine visibility, the monthly newsletter, nurture flows and customer case studies.
Own growth operations: HubSpot administration, lead scoring and routing, campaign tracking (UTMs, PostHog) and funnel dashboards.
Equip Sales with proposals, battlecards, account briefs and discovery prompts grounded in the product to assist in moving customers through the pipeline .
Collaborate with ecosystem partners to drive adoption and amplify reach through coordinated GTM efforts.
Contribute to OKRs and performance tracking frameworks, and manage marketing budget and paid campaigns against named opportunities.
What you'll need:
5+ years of experience in product marketing or a similar function in crypto, fintech, or developer tools and infrastructure
Demonstrated success launching and scaling product launches end to end, with quantifiable outcomes
Strong copywriting and storytelling skills - able to distill complexity into clarity
Hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, lead scoring, pipelines and reporting
Analytical in nature, with a strong ability to set up tracking, read funnels and tie marketing work to pipeline and revenue
Comfort navigating ambiguity and solving open-ended problems with structure and i

title: Global KOL Manager
description_excerpt:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.


About the Role

Trust Wallet is looking for a Global KOL Manager to lead and scale our global influencer, creator, and community ecosystem.

In this role, you will identify, build, and manage relationships with influential KOLs, content creators, and affiliate partners across key crypto markets, while also helping grow and engage Trust Wallet's global communities. You will work closely with our Growth, Marketing, Community, and Product teams to develop impactful creator partnerships and community programs that drive brand awareness, user acquisition, engagement, retention, and measurable business growth.

We're looking for someone who is deeply connected to the crypto ecosystem, understands how crypto communities and influencers operate, and can turn strong KOL relationships into scalable growth opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

1. Global KOL Strategy & Network Development

 - Develop and execute KOL growth strategies across key global markets.

 - Identify, recruit, and maintain strong relationships with high-impact crypto influencers, creators, and community leaders across X, YouTube, Telegram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

 - Build and manage a diversified KOL network across different tiers, audiences, regions, and content verticals.

 - Continuously discover emerging influencers, market trends, and new creator partnership opportunities.

2. KOL Partnerships & Affiliate Growth

 - Negotiate and manage KOL collaborations, including paid sponsorships, affiliate partnerships, ambassador programs, and long-term strategic relationships.

 - Develop incentive structures that align KOL performance with Trust Wallet's growth objectives.

 - Drive measurable results through KOL partnerships, including user acquisition, product adoption, trading activity, and revenue contribution.

3. Campaign Execution & Cross-functional Collaboration

 - Work closely with Growth, Marketing, Social, and Product teams to execute KOL activations for product launches, marketing campaigns, and ecosystem initiatives.

title: KOL and Social Manager
description_excerpt:
ABOUT US

ether.fi http://ether.fi/ is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.

The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi-cash and Stake https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for a KOL and Social Manager to find, sign and manage KOLs (key opinion leaders: creators and influencers) who bring real users to ether.fi, and to run our day-to-day social posting. This is a user acquisition role: a KOL partnership is worth keeping only if it refers quality users.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Research and scrape to find KOLs whose audiences match our users

 - Build your own tools to speed up sourcing and tracking, using AI-assisted coding (vibe coding)

 - Recruit KOLs, set them up with referral tracking and manage the relationships

 - Track referred users per KOL and cut partnerships that don't perform

 - Spend about an hour a day posting across ether.fi's social channels




YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 - Build a roster of 10-20 KOLs, each referring more than 50 quality users a month




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You can vibe code: you build simple tools and scripts with AI to get work done faster

 - Strong research skills, including scraping to build lists and find people

 - Comfortable posting and running social accounts daily

 - Prior KOL experience is not required

 - Drive, willingness to work hard and go the extra mile. We are a highly ambitious, driven team with audacious goals, and we work very hard to make them a reality
